note: Camrose County campground on a point on Buffalo Lake's north shore, 10 km east of Bashaw on Hwy 53 and 6 km south on Range Road 204, beside a large sandy family beach, a marina and boat launch. Sites 32-39 on the loop's southwest side back onto the open beach; the rest face the loop or the access road. Caretaker on site; concession, mini golf and a camp kitchen. Taps are non-potable: drinking water is sold by coin at the Bashaw ag grounds. --Claude
summary: Read the Camrose County page, its 2026 site map and the Campspot record: unserviced C$25, 30 A C$40, 50 A C$50 (GST in) + C$5 booking fee; 56 sites (46 power); showers, dump, non-potable taps; season May 8 - Sep 13 (2026); books on Campspot (2027 opens Jan 15). Lakefront kept with a caveat naming sites 32-39; phone and second website wrong.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - keep, with a caveat): the county site map puts sites 32, 34, 36, 37 and 39 on the southwest side of the point loop facing the beach. On imagery the RV pads there sit on the loop's outer edge with open sand (no trees, no road, no lawn use) running to the waterline ~40-45 m away at this year's low level; the high-water edge is closer. The swim beach with the day-use icons is north-west of sites 12-31, not in front of the loop. Sites 41-45 at the south tip face a grassy/reedy flat 100+ m wide; sites 46-50 on the east side face the access road and the marina channel; the rest are inside the loop. Recommend lakefront with the note naming sites 32-39 (proposed). Campspot tags the park 'Waterfront' (park feature), describing 'waterfront views'.

PHONE: stored 780-372-4022 appears only in aggregators (AllStays, Campendium); the county page's contact is 'Camrose County Agriculture Services ... Phone: 587-322-1122' (group camping 780-672-4765), and Campspot's park record gives phoneNumber 5873221122. Recommend 587-322-1122.

WEBSITE: the county URL redirects (200) to https://county.camrose.ab.ca/visit/parks/pelican-point-park/ - give that. The second stored URL https://www.pelicanpointalberta.com/about is the Pelican Point Community Association (the cottage subdivision's residents' association: 'Hello, All Residents and Visitors', membership, AGM), not the campground - replace it with the Campspot booking page https://www.campspot.com/book/pelican-point-campground-camrose-county-ab (the county page's RESERVATIONS button; www.campspot.com/park/... answered CloudFront 403 to curl, the API answered in the browser).
STATUS: the county page says 'The Pelican Point Campground is now CLOSED. Reservations for the 2027 season can be made starting at 12:00 am on January 15th 2027.' - the seasonal close, not a status.

PRICE/FIT: the base C$25 is the unserviced sites (1-11, by the parking); neither the page nor the map gives site lengths, and Campspot returned no availability for 2027-06-15 (season not loaded), so lengths are unread. If the reviewer wants the base on a known-fit site, the 30 A rate is C$40. All under the C$69 gate either way (local entry). Campspot rating 4.5 from 112 reviews. Site counts differ slightly: the page '56 sites - 46 power'; the map numbers 1-58 with 11 unserviced.
PIN (52.52322,-112.82683): in the centre of the point loop - OK (Campspot's park point 52.523101,-112.827538 is ~50 m away).
